items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: if you didn't already know the existing body of work and you were to hear uh solos by Edmund Hall and Raymond Burke it would be uh virtually impossible for you to determine which one was the white one which one was the black one

ctx.x: but when some of those solos uh come through the early

the early things didn't even have the solos yeah there was no way that you could tell so so that uh no longer becomes a consideration and of course there were many white musicians and and still are white musicians who are not distinguishable in their sounds from black ones for example if you didn't already know the existing body of work and you were to hear uh solos by Edmund Hall and Raymond Burke it would be uh virtually impossible for you to determine which one was the white one which one was the black one…
